scenario: We're about to turn on this new deploy pipeline for production. Review it first.
fixture: evaluations/fixtures/deploy-pipeline-reviewer/ — orders-api repo with a new GitHub Actions deploy workflow, a lint workflow, Dockerfile, deploy script, a column-drop migration and a CHANGELOG describing the release.
required_behaviors: flags the pull_request_target trigger combined with checkout of github.event.pull_request.head.sha in jobs that have prod secrets and a write-all token as P0
flags the secret echo and the env dump written to deploy-env.txt and uploaded as an artifact, and calls for removing it and rotating the credentials
flags that the deploy job does not need the test job, runs on pushes to any branch, and has no environment protection or approval

flags migration 0042 as a destructive drop shipped in the same release that stops reading the column, recommends expand/contract across releases, and says expand migrations must run before deploy rather than after
gives an explicit NO-GO with concrete fix snippets and an ordered list of what must change before enabling
forbidden_behaviors: approving the pipeline as-is or giving GO / GO WITH CONDITIONS while P0s stand
flagging lint.yml (pull_request trigger, contents: read, SHA-pinned actions, no secrets) as a security issue
grading_notes: Compare against evaluations/answers/deploy-pipeline-reviewer.md. Pass requires all five required behaviors and neither forbidden behavior. Supply-chain, Dockerfile, OIDC, concurrency and deploy.sh findings are expected for a strong run but individually not required. Severity +/-1 on P2/P3 items is acceptable.
